panel.introduction: Selam is the first contact-binary moon discovered around an asteroid. Lucy revealed its two touching lobes while passing Dinkinesh in November 2023. Approximate orbital placement. The 3.11 km separation and 52.67-hour period are measured; circular equatorial motion and synchronous orientation are approximations. The present orbital phase is illustrative.

controls.label: Shape
controls.title: Measured two-lobe envelope
controls.description: Two touching ellipsoids reproduce the lobe dimensions inferred from Lucy images: 240 × 200 × 200 m and 280 × 220 × 210 m, each uncertain by about 10%. This is a smooth shape envelope; the neck, craters and surface imagery are unresolved in this representation.
